fees.note: From the county's rates page (read 2026-10-13): RV sites with electric and water $30 a night.  Campspot, where the RV sites were closed for the season on October 20, 2026, quoted the same $30 on every RV site type, plus a $2 'Transaction Fee' once per stay.

source: https://www.stutsmancounty.gov/departments/parks/campground-policies/ (Lakeside Campground: 'RV Campsites With Electrical & Water - $30.00/night'), read 2026-10-13; https://www.campspot.com/park/lakeside-campground-jamestown-nd (quotes for 2026-10-20 while the RV sites are closed: $30 on each RV site type plus a $2 'Transaction Fee', which a two-night search shows is charged once per stay; campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl, campspot_dates.py), read 2026-10-13

fees.note: From the park's rates page (read 2026-10-13): RV sites with water and electric $25 a night Sunday to Wednesday and $30 Thursday to Saturday; full-hookup sites $35 and $40.  Memorial Day, Fourth of July and Labor Day weekends cost $5 more a night and need 3 nights.  Campspot, closed for the season from October 13, 2026 until May 2027, quoted the same $25 and $35 for a Tuesday in October, plus 13% of the site charge as a 'Campspot and Daily Transaction Fee'.

source: https://lazyfish.camp/rates.html (RV site and full-hookup rates by day of the week; the holiday-weekend rule), read 2026-10-13; https://www.campspot.com/park/lazy-fish-at-pelican-point (quotes for 2026-10-20 while the park is closed: $25 and $35 plus 13% 'Campspot and Daily Transaction Fee'; campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl), read 2026-10-13

fees.note: From the fairgrounds' RV page (read 2026-10-13): sites with sewer and 50-amp power $45 a night, power only $40 and dry camping $20, before taxes and fees.  Campspot sold the sewer sites for $40, the same as power only, on every date read in October 2026, January 2027 and June 2027 (the sewer closes on October 1), plus the fairgrounds' $6 'Booking Fee' once per stay.

source: https://gallatincountyfairgrounds.com/rv-parking (Sewer & Electricity Hookups $45/night, Electric Only Sites $40/night, Dry Camping $20/night, 'not including taxes and fees'), read 2026-10-13; https://www.campspot.com/park/gallatin-county-fairgrounds-bozeman-mt (Campspot's pricing for each RV site type, one night from 2026-10-17, 2026-10-20, 2027-01-26, 2027-01-30, 2027-06-08, 2027-06-12, 2 adults; two nights from each Tuesday for the park's fees; campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl), read 2026-10-13

fees.note: Read on Campspot (2026-10-13): both RV site types, full hookups with 30-amp or 30/50-amp power, are listed at $55 a night for 2 adults before tax.  Campspot has shown the campground closed to online booking since January 2024, though the county's site still sends 'Reserve a Campsite' there and publishes no rates of its own.

source: https://www.campspot.com/book/ferguscounty (Campspot's listed price for each RV site type on 2027-06-08 and 2027-06-12, 2 adults, while the park record shows the campground closed from 2024-01-01 on; campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl), read 2026-10-13; https://fceventcenter.com/ ('Reserve a Campsite' links to Campspot; no rates on the site), read 2026-10-13

fees.note: From the park's reservation pages (read 2026-10-13): a single dry site, for one camping unit, is $16 a night, or $13 in the winter season from October 15 to April 15; a double site, for two camping units, is twice that.  Montana's 8% bed tax is added.  On Campspot a single site cost $12 and a double $15 on dates in October 2026 and January 2027, plus the park's $5 'Reservation Fee' once per stay and 3% of the site charge as a 'Credit Card fee'.  June 2027 isn't open for booking yet.

source: https://www.thesilosmt.camp/reserve (Rustic - Single $16/night, Rustic - Double $32/night, + 8% MT Bed Tax), read 2026-10-13; https://www.thesilosmt.camp/winter-season (winter season October 15 - April 15: Rustic - Single $13/night, Rustic - Double $26/night), read 2026-10-13; https://www.campspot.com/book/siloscampground (Campspot's pricing for each RV site type, one night from 2026-10-17, 2026-10-20, 2027-01-26, 2027-01-30, 2 adults; two nights from each Tuesday for the park's fees; campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl), read 2026-10-13
